experiment: K15 missing cell: new common background plus fixed amplification of the adapted model's own instruction response

conditions.new_gain: mu_new + alpha*(v_new(actual q)-mu_new); no old-model output used to produce the velocity
conditions.old_gain: mu_old + alpha*(v_new(actual q)-mu_new); exact replication of K14 S5 canonical corrected group
conditions.native: adapted native actual-q policy; exact replication of K14 A_nat

queries: means from canonical Left/Right, actual q separately forwarded, same current observation/draft/time; never choose +/- by target
action_dimensions: formula applied to all 32 denoising dimensions, matching K14 S5; only first7 physical dimensions executed
snapshots: same 20 K14 saved Front-prefix stable-grasp common snapshots, exact full boundary signature
timing: 60 control steps from saved boundary; after window adapted native same q to absolute400
noise_and_refresh: unchanged K14 snapshot seed, global replan index, execute10 then refresh observation
analysis: paired comparisons by physical snapshot, 10000 bootstrap resamples over20 snapshots, 95% interval; retain per-instruction counts
comparison_rules: report new_gain-native and new_gain-old_gain; use delta0.15 and CI lower>0 as K14 clearly-better descriptive rule; point difference<=0.10 is descriptive closeness only, NOT equivalence
interpretation_limits: development states; alpha fixed, no tuning if failed; cannot generalize to every gain, other tasks or semantic understanding
baseline_audit: native and old_gain must reproduce archived K14 per-episode outcomes AND complete400-step traces; investigate mismatch before attributing new results
